briefdescription.para: Wrapper around MappedBlockStream::createIndexedStream() that checks if a stream with that index actually exists.

detaileddescription.para: If it does not, the return value will have an MSFError with code msf_error_code::no_stream. Else, the return value will contain the stream returned by createIndexedStream().
